text: OBOS says it is owned by more than half a million members; the Brønnøysund register lists OBOS BBL as a boligbyggelag (housing cooperative).
short: OBOS, a housing cooperative, is owned by its more than 500,000 members.

source.name: OBOS: Om OBOS
source.quote: OBOS er en av Nordens største boligbyggere, eid av over en halv million medlemmer.
